allowOutOfRange.description: If true, values entered by typing or pasting are not clamped to min and max. Stepping with the buttons, keyboard, mouse wheel, or scrub area still respects the bounds.

allowWheelScrub.description: If true, the mouse wheel adjusts the value while the input is focused and hovered.

autoFocus.description: If true, the input element is focused during the first mount.

classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

color.description: The color of the component. It supports both default and custom theme colors, which can be added as shown in the palette customization guide.

controlsPosition.description: The arrangement of the control buttons. Use 'end' for horizontal minus/plus buttons at the end, 'split' for a minus button at the start and a plus button at the end, 'stacked' for up/down chevrons at the end, or false for no control buttons.

defaultValue.description: The initial numeric value for an uncontrolled field. Omit this prop to start with an empty field. Use value for a controlled field.

error.description: If true, the field is displayed in an error state.

form.description: The id of the form that owns the field. Use this prop when the field is rendered outside the form.

format.description:
Options passed to Intl.NumberFormat to format the displayed value. The value prop and value callbacks use numbers or null, regardless of the display format.
See Intl.NumberFormat.

fullWidth.description: If true, the input will take up the full width of its container.

id.description: The id of the visible input, used to associate its label and helper text. If omitted, an ID is generated.

inputRef.description: A ref to the visible <input> element.

largeStep.description: The amount to increment or decrement while holding the Shift key.

locale.description:
The locale or locales used to format and parse the value. Defaults to the runtime's locale.
See Intl.NumberFormat.

max.description: The upper bound for the numeric value. The increment button is disabled at or above this value.

min.description: The lower bound for the numeric value. The decrement button is disabled at or below this value.

name.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted. The submitted value is the unformatted number.

onBlur.description: Callback fired when the input loses focus.

onFocus.description: Callback fired when the input receives focus.

onValueChange.description: Callback fired when the numeric value changes. Call eventDetails.cancel() to reject the proposed change.

value.name: value
value.description: The new numeric value, or null when the input is empty.

eventDetails.name: eventDetails
eventDetails.description: The interaction details, including the native event and a reason: "input-change", "input-clear", "input-blur", "input-paste", "keyboard", "increment-press", "decrement-press", "wheel", "scrub", or "none".

onValueCommitted.description: Callback fired when the value is committed. Direct text entry commits on blur. Pointer presses on the stepper buttons and scrub interactions commit on pointer release. Keyboard and wheel changes commit immediately.

value.name: value
value.description: The committed numeric value, or null when the input is empty.

eventDetails.name: eventDetails
eventDetails.description: The interaction details, including the native event and a reason: "input-blur", "input-clear", "keyboard", "increment-press", "decrement-press", "wheel", "scrub", or "none".

placeholder.description: The short hint displayed in the input when it is empty.

readOnly.description: If true, the value cannot be changed through user interaction. The input can still receive focus.

required.description: If true, a value is required for form submission and the label is marked as required.

scrubArea.description: The placement of the drag handle used to adjust the value. Use 'start' or 'end' to show the handle, or false to hide it. Its position is independent of controlsPosition.

slotProps.description: The props used for each slot inside.

slots.description: The components used for each slot inside.

smallStep.description: The amount to increment or decrement while holding the Alt key (Option on macOS).

snapOnStep.description: If true, stepping snaps the value to intervals starting at min, or 0 if min is omitted. Modifier keys use the corresponding smallStep or largeStep intervals.

step.description: The amount to increment or decrement with the buttons, arrow keys, mouse wheel, or scrub area. Set min explicitly to enable step validation on form submission. Set to "any" to disable step validation; interactive stepping then uses 1, while the Alt and Shift keys still use smallStep and largeStep.

sx.description: The system prop that allows defining system overrides as well as additional CSS styles.

value.description: The controlled numeric value. Use null to display an empty field and onValueChange to update the value.

slotDescriptions.decrementButton: The component that renders the decrement button.
slotDescriptions.formHelperText: The component that renders the helper text.
slotDescriptions.htmlInput: The component that renders the native input element.
slotDescriptions.incrementButton: The component that renders the increment button.
slotDescriptions.input: The component that renders the Material input wrapper.
slotDescriptions.inputLabel: The component that renders the input's label.
slotDescriptions.root: The component that renders the root.
slotDescriptions.scrubArea: The component that renders the drag handle for adjusting the value.
slotDescriptions.scrubAreaCursor: The component that renders the custom cursor while dragging the scrub area.
